title: Squirtle’s Shell Was Built for More Than Defense
premise: Squirtle’s shell protects it, but its rounded shape and grooves also minimize water resistance for fast swimming.
audiencePromise: Reveal why Squirtle’s protective shell is also shaped to move through water faster.
openLoop: Why would a protective shell be shaped for speed?
payoff: Squirtle’s rounded shell and surface grooves minimize resistance, enabling high-speed swimming.
engagementQuestion: In danger, would you trust its shell or its speed?

voice.instructions: Begin with a quiet mystery, then build the contradiction with crisp, quick delivery. Make the resistance reveal sound like the answer snapping into place. End with an inviting, playful challenge.

scenes.headline: MORE THAN DEFENSE
scenes.narration: Squirtle's shell was built for more than defense.
scenes.caption: THIS SHIELD HAS A HIDDEN PURPOSE

scenes.headline: IT BECOMES RESILIENT ARMOR
scenes.narration: Its shell starts soft, then soon hardens into resilient armor.
scenes.caption: SO ITS JOB SEEMS OBVIOUS

scenes.headline: NOT MERELY PROTECTION
scenes.narration: Yet the Pokédex says this shell is not merely protection.
scenes.caption: ARMOR IS ONLY THE FIRST ANSWER

scenes.headline: ROUND WITH SURFACE GROOVES
scenes.narration: Its rounded shape and grooves minimize resistance in water.
scenes.caption: WATER FLOW SLIDES AROUND THE SHELL

scenes.headline: A SHELL MADE TO MOVE
scenes.narration: That lets Squirtle swim at high speeds, not just hide.
scenes.caption: DEFENSE OUTSIDE. SPEED BUILT IN.

scenes.headline: HIDE OR SWIM FAST?
scenes.narration: In danger, would you trust its shell or its speed?
scenes.caption: PROTECTION OR HIGH-SPEED ESCAPE?
